a.xlink:title: --- stage: build script: - echo "Building with basic retry configuration" - echo "This job will retry up to 2 times on any failure" retry: 2
--- stage: test script: - echo "Running tests with timeout" - echo "This job has a 30 minute timeout" - sleep 5 timeout: 30m retry: 1
--- stage: test script: - echo "Running quick tests" - echo "This job has a 5 minute timeout" timeout: 5 minutes
--- stage: test script: - echo "Running interruptible tests" - echo "This job can be cancelled if a newer pipeline starts" - sleep 10 interruptible: true timeout: 1h
--- stage: test script: - echo "Running critical tests" - echo "This job cannot be interrupted" interruptible: false timeout: 45m

--- stage: test script: - echo "Running tests with complex retry logic" - echo "Different retry strategies for different failures" retry: max: 5 when: - unknown_failure - script_failure - api_failure - stuck_or_timeout_failure - runner_system_failure - job_execution_timeout - archived_failure - unmet_prerequisites - scheduler_failure - data_integrity_failure timeout: 20m interruptible: true
--- stage: test script: - echo "Starting long-running test suite" - echo "This job has a 3 hour timeout" timeout: 3h retry: 1 interruptible: true
--- stage: test script: - echo "Running tests with precise timeout" - echo "Timeout specified in seconds" timeout: 300s retry: 2
--- stage: deploy script: - echo "Deploying to production" - echo "No retries - deployment failures require manual intervention" retry: 0 timeout: 15m interruptible: false

--- stage: deploy script: - echo "Deploying to staging" - echo "Only retry on infrastructure issues" retry: max: 2 when: - runner_system_failure - stuck_or_timeout_failure timeout: 10m interruptible: true

--- stage: deploy script: - echo "Complex deployment job" - echo "Has timeout, retry, and interruptible settings" - sleep 3 retry: max: 3 when: - runner_system_failure - api_failure timeout: 2h interruptible: false

--- stage: build script: - echo "Building with conditional retry" - echo "Will retry only on specific failure types" retry: max: 3 when: - runner_system_failure - stuck_or_timeout_failure - script_failure
--- stage: build script: - echo "Building with selective retry" - echo "Only retries on infrastructure failures" retry: max: 2 when: - runner_system_failure - api_failure
